title: aws-sdk-js-v3 ListBucketsCommand
means: console.log(await S3.send(new ListBucketsCommand({}))) prints the account's buckets, each with its Name and CreationDate, and the Owner.

title: aws-sdk-js-v3 ListObjectsV2Command
means: console.log(await S3.send(new ListObjectsV2Command({ Bucket: "my-bucket" }))) prints the bucket's objects (Key, LastModified, ETag, Size, StorageClass), IsTruncated, KeyCount, MaxKeys and Name.

title: aws-sdk-js-v3 presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/dog.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=..." -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @dog.png uploads to the specified bucket and key until the presigned link expires.

title: aws-sdk-js listBuckets
means: console.log(await s3.listBuckets().promise()) prints the buckets and the Owner.

title: aws-sdk-js listObjects
means: console.log(await s3.listObjects({ Bucket: "my-bucket" }).promise()) prints IsTruncated, Name, MaxKeys and the objects, each with its Key, LastModified, ETag, Size and an Owner ([Object]).

title: aws-sdk-js presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/dog.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=..." -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @dog.png

title: aws-cli list-buckets
means: aws s3api list-buckets prints the buckets, and an Owner whose DisplayName and ID are the same 32-hex id.

title: aws-cli list-objects-v2
means: aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket my-bucket prints the bucket's objects.

title: aws4fetch ListBuckets
means: await client.fetch(R2_URL) answers the ListAllMyBucketsResult XML the page prints.

title: aws4fetch ListObjectsV2
means: await client.fetch(`${R2_URL}/my-bucket?list-type=2`) answers the ListBucketResult XML the page prints (its listing is cut off after the second object's LastModified).

title: aws4fetch presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/my-bucket/dog.png?X-Amz-Expires=3600&..." -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @dog.png

title: boto3 upload_fileobj
means: # Upload single file: s3.upload_fileobj(f, "my-bucket", "dog.png") with ./dog.png opened for reading.

title: boto3 head_object
means: # Get object metadata: s3.head_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="dog.png")

title: boto3 get_object
means: # Get object: response = s3.get_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="dog.png")

title: boto3 presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/my-bucket/dog.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=..." -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @dog.png

title: boto3 delete_object
means: # Delete object: s3.delete_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="dog.png")

title: aws-sdk-go ListObjectsV2
means: client.ListObjectsV2 on bucketName "sdk-example"; the page prints each object of Contents as JSON (ETag, Key, LastModified, Owner null, Size, StorageClass).

title: aws-sdk-go ListBuckets
means: client.ListBuckets(context.TODO(), &s3.ListBucketsInput{}) lists the account's buckets.

title: aws-sdk-java listBuckets
means: s3Client.listBuckets().buckets() lists the account's buckets.

title: aws-sdk-java listObjectsV2
means: s3Client.listObjectsV2(request).contents() lists a bucket's objects; the bucket is the method's bucketName parameter, which the page leaves to the reader.

title: aws-sdk-java putObject example.txt
means: r2Client.putObject(bucketName, "example.txt", "Hello, R2!") writes Hello, R2! to example.txt in the reader's bucket (bucketName).

title: aws-sdk-java listObjects
means: r2Client.listObjects(bucketName) lists the reader's bucket (bucketName).

title: aws-sdk-kotlin listBuckets
means: r2Client.listBuckets().buckets prints "* ${bucket.name}" for each bucket.

title: aws-sdk-kotlin listObjects
means: r2Client.listObjects { bucket = bucketName } prints each object's key, size and last modified; bucketName is "<BUCKET_NAME>", the reader's.

title: aws-sdk-kotlin presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://<your-presigned-put-url>" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary "@local-file.txt", to the URL presignPutObject made for key README.md in <BUCKET_NAME>.

title: aws-sdk-kotlin presigned GET with curl
means: curl -X GET "https://<your-presigned-get-url>" -o downloaded-file.txt, from the URL presignGetObject made for key README.md in <BUCKET_NAME>.

title: aws-sdk-net ListBuckets
means: s3Client.ListBucketsAsync() writes each bucket's name.

title: aws-sdk-net ListObjectsV2
means: new ListObjectsV2Request { BucketName = "my-bucket" } writes each object's key.

title: aws-sdk-net GetObject file.txt
means: s3Client.GetObjectAsync("my-bucket", "file.txt") writes the object's ETag.

title: aws-sdk-php listObjectsV2
means: $s3_client->listObjectsV2(['Bucket' => 'my-bucket']) and var_dump($contents['Contents']) prints each object's Key (ferriswasm.png), LastModified, ETag, Size and StorageClass.

title: aws-sdk-php listBuckets
means: $s3_client->listBuckets() and var_dump($buckets['Buckets']) prints each bucket's Name (my-bucket) and CreationDate.

title: aws-sdk-php presigned PUT with curl
means: curl -X PUT "https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/ferriswasm.png?X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&..." uploads with the presigned putObject link.

title: aws-sdk-ruby list_buckets
means: puts @r2.list_buckets prints :buckets (each :name and :creation_date) and :owner (:display_name and :id).

title: aws-sdk-ruby list_objects_v2
means: # List the first 20 items in a bucket: @r2.list_objects_v2(bucket: "your-bucket", max_keys: 20) prints :is_truncated false, :name, :max_keys 20, :key_count 3 and three :contents.

title: aws-sdk-rust list_buckets
means: client.list_buckets().send() prints each bucket's name and creation date.

title: aws-sdk-rust list_objects_v2
means: client.list_objects_v2().bucket(bucket_name) with bucket_name "sdk-example" prints each object.

title: aws-sdk-rust put_object
means: client.put_object().bucket(bucket).key(key).body(ByteStream::from_path(file_path)) uploads a file; bucket, key and file are the function's parameters, the reader's.

title: aws-sdk-rust get_object
means: client.get_object().bucket(bucket).key(key) downloads the object and writes its body to output_path; bucket and key are the reader's.

title: s3mini putObject hello.txt
means: await s3.putObject("hello.txt", "Hello from s3mini!") with the bucket-scoped endpoint https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/my-bucket.

title: s3mini getObject hello.txt
means: const text = await s3.getObject("hello.txt") reads back the text.

title: s3mini listObjects with prefix hello
means: // List objects with a prefix: await s3.listObjects("/", "hello")

title: s3mini deleteObject hello.txt
means: await s3.deleteObject("hello.txt")

title: custom header cf-create-bucket-if-missing with boto3
means: put_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="my_file", Body="file_contents") with the header cf-create-bucket-if-missing: true.

title: custom header cf-create-bucket-if-missing with aws-sdk-js-v3
means: new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "my_key", Body: "my_data" }) with request.headers["cf-create-bucket-if-missing"] = "true".

title: custom header If-Match with boto3
means: put_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="my_key", Body="file_contents", custom_headers={'If-Match': '"29d911f495d1ba7cb3a4d7d15e63236a"'}); "boto3 will throw an exception if the precondition failed".

title: presigned GET with curl
means: # Download using a GET presigned URL: curl "https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/image.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=..."

title: presigned PUT with curl
means: # Upload using a PUT presigned URL: curl -X PUT "https://my-bucket.<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/image.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=..." --data-binary @image.png

title: upload PutObjectCommand
means: new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "image.png", Body: fileContent, ContentType: "image/png" }), then console.log(`Uploaded successfully. ETag: ${response.ETag}`) (and boto3's put_object with the same).

title: download GetObjectCommand
means: new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "image.png" }) (and boto3's get_object with the same) reads the object's body.

title: delete DeleteObjectCommand
means: new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "image.png" }) (and boto3's delete_object with the same) deletes the object.

title: putBucketLifecycleConfiguration five rules
means: client.putBucketLifecycleConfiguration on Bucket "testBucket", the page's stand-in for the reader's bucket, with five rules: Delete 2019 Documents (Filter Prefix 2019/, Expiration Date 2024-01-01), Transition Objects To Infrequent Access (Transitions Days 30 STANDARD_IA), Delete Old Logs (Filter Prefix logs/, Expiration Days 90), Abort Incomplete Multipart Uploads (DaysAfterInitiation 7), Abort User Incomplete Multipart Uploads (Filter Prefix useruploads/, DaysAfterInitiation 1).

title: getBucketLifecycleConfiguration
means: // Get lifecycle configuration for bucket: client.getBucketLifecycleConfiguration({ Bucket: "bucketName" }), bucketName standing for the reader's bucket.

title: CreateBucket with location hint WNAM
means: You can set the Location Hint via the LocationConstraint parameter using the S3 API: new CreateBucketCommand({ Bucket: "YOUR_BUCKET_NAME", CreateBucketConfiguration: { LocationConstraint: "WNAM" } }).

title: CreateBucket in the eu jurisdiction
means: The example below shows how to create an R2 bucket in the eu jurisdiction: an S3Client with endpoint https://<account_id>.eu.r2.cloudflarestorage.com sends new CreateBucketCommand({ Bucket: "YOUR_BUCKET_NAME" }).

title: copy-object to Infrequent Access
means: aws s3api copy-object --bucket bucket-name --key path/to/object.txt --copy-source /bucket-name/path/to/object.txt --storage-class STANDARD_IA moves an object to Infrequent Access by copying it onto itself.

title: CORS policy for presigned uploads
means: Add a CORS policy to your bucket that allows requests from your application's origin: [{"AllowedOrigins": ["https://example.com"], "AllowedMethods": ["PUT"], "AllowedHeaders": ["Content-Type"], "ExposeHeaders": ["ETag"], "MaxAgeSeconds": 3600}]; the page adds it on the dashboard or with wrangler, and the S3 API's PutBucketCors carries the same rule.

title: GetObject with temporary credentials
means: await client.fetch(`${R2_URL}/my-bucket/image.png`) with an AwsClient signing with temporary credentials.

title: implicit CreateBucket of cf-create-bucket-if-missing
means: If the bucket does not exist at the time of upload, it is implicitly instantiated with the following CreateBucket request: PUT / HTTP/1.1, Host: bucket.account.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, <CreateBucketConfiguration><LocationConstraint>auto</LocationConstraint></CreateBucketConfiguration>.
